key_idea: Go around the bracelet and check the beads in order.
steps: Start at the red circle on top of Nora's bracelet and go around like a clock's hands.
Nora's order is: red circle, blue square, yellow triangle, green circle, purple star, pink square.
B has the same beads in the same places, so it is the same bracelet.

choice_feedback.A: The red circle and the blue square have swapped places.
choice_feedback.C: Going round the same way, the beads come in a different order than Nora's.
choice_feedback.D: This bracelet has a red triangle, but Nora's triangle is yellow.
choice_feedback.E: The purple star and the pink square have swapped places.

review.note: Two possible answers: C is Nora's bracelet with the beads in the reverse order (the same bracelet turned over). If turning a bracelet over counts as the same, C also matches. Choice feedback for C only says the order differs when going round the same way.
